fan.prompt: A small brushless computer ventilation fan already running at constant speed. A perfectly steady smooth soft flow of air with a faint continuous electric motor tone. Consistent uninterrupted texture from start to finish, close perspective, acoustically damped enclosure, anechoic recording.

start.prompt: A vintage computer powering on: one small relay engages, followed immediately by a brief clean two-note electronic confirmation chirp, low then higher note, restrained and friendly. One isolated startup cue with a quick decay.

stop.prompt: One small vintage computer power relay disengages, a muted mechanical clack with a tiny spring release, short dry power-off switch click, quick decay.

fault.prompt: A vintage computer error alert: a short low electronic buzzer with two restrained descending pulses, clean simple oscillator, dry and modest, clearly an error indication, quick decay.

burn.prompt: A vintage EPROM programmer finishes writing: one tiny relay click followed by a short clear high electronic success chirp, precise simple oscillator, warm and restrained, quick decay.

relay.prompt: One miniature electromechanical relay actuates inside a vintage computer, a single crisp soft metallic tick with a subtle plastic body, very short dry click, quick decay.

terminal.prompt: One tiny teletype print hammer striking, a soft crisp dry tick from a vintage computer terminal, small and delicate, very quick decay.

card_write.prompt: One row punched into a paper punch card, a tight cluster of tiny metal punches striking thin stiff card stock, short dry mechanical clack with fine papery grit, quick decay.

card_feed.prompt: A compact punched card machine feeds one card: small rubber rollers engage, a short smooth motor stroke pulls stiff card stock, then a soft mechanical end-stop, one complete short transport movement.
